name: klipy-gif-search
title: KLIPY GIF Search
description: Search KLIPY, import local GIFs, and copy web-optimized files
author: amixaam

commands.name: search-gifs
commands.title: Search KLIPY GIFs
commands.description: Search, favorite, import, optimize, and copy GIFs

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: KLIPY API Key
preferences.description: Create a free test or production key at partner.klipy.com

preferences.name: maxSizeMB
preferences.title: Maximum GIF Size (MB)
preferences.description: Imported and downloaded GIFs are optimized below this size when possible

preferences.name: optimizeThresholdKB
preferences.title: Optimization Threshold (KB)
preferences.description: GIFs at or below this size are copied without optimization

preferences.name: maxDimension
preferences.title: Maximum Width or Height
preferences.description: Large GIFs are scaled down to this many pixels before copying

preferences.name: contentFilter
preferences.title: Content Filter
preferences.description: Choose the KLIPY safety level used for searches and trending results

commands.name: import-gifs
commands.title: Import Local GIFs
commands.description: Add local GIF files to your searchable library
